summary: Joining a congregation's projects gives a newcomer a set of regular faces, because religious groups are where the largest share of volunteers serve.
realLife: The Bureau of Labor Statistics found about a third of volunteers served mainly with a religious organization, ahead of educational or youth groups and community service groups.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Volunteering in the United States news release: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/volun.nr0.htm
inGame: needs: congregations as organizations; ties to neighbors who attend can stand in until then.

turns.summary: The newcomer is soon known by name and asked to take on more.
The newcomer is polite but finds the circle closed.
A school project draws the newcomer away.
